question: The compound interest on a certain sum at a rate of 12% per annum for 2 years is ₹ 1,590. The simple interest on the same sum for double the time period and at half the interest rate per annum is:
solution:
**Given:**

Compound interest = ₹ 1,590

Time = 2 years

Rate of interest = 12 %

**Formula used:**

C.I = P[(1 + R/100)T - 1]

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Here, P = Sum, T = Time, And R = Rate

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be P

According to the question,

1590 = P[(1 + 12/100)² - 1]

⇒ 1590 = P[(1 + 3/25)2 - 1]

⇒ 1590 = P[(28/25)2 - 1]

⇒ 1590 = P[(784/625) - 1]

⇒ 1590 = P[(784 - 625)/625]

⇒ 1590 = P[159/625]

⇒ (1590 × 625)\159 = P

⇒ 6250 = P

So, the sum = ₹ 6250

Now, S.I = (6250 × 4 × 6)/100

⇒ 62.5 × 24 = 1500

**∴ The required simple interest is ₹ 1,500.**
